related.title: BatchNorm：批次統計與推論狀態
related.titleEn: BatchNorm: batch statistics and evaluation state
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付雙路更新圖、零梯度測試及參數群組表。；1.998與1.996吻合，零梯度/None差異與群組設定有紀錄。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver update paths, zero-gradient tests and parameter groups.; Values match and zero/None behavior and group settings are documented.
related.difference: 列批次、通道及空間軸，註明此題母體變異；把running統計與當批統計分開。；兩值吻合，母體/樣本變異慣例明示，eval批次不變性測試通過。
related.differenceEn: Label batch,channel and spatial axes, specifying population variance here and separating running from batch statistics.; Values match, variance convention is explicit and evaluation batch-invariance tests pass.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 在顯式零梯度且先前兩個Adam動量皆為零的示例中θ新=(1−ηλ)θ；若舊動量非零仍有梯度路更新。衰減不先混入動量。；教學θ2,η.01,λ.1；顯式梯度及先前兩個動量皆為0；改λ.2。；θ新=(1−.01×.1)×2=1.998；改後1.996。
y=γ(x−μ)/√(variance+ε)+β；統計軸與訓練/推論狀態必須明確。；教學同通道兩值2,4，均值3、母體變異1；取x4,ε1e−5,β0,γ1，再改γ2。；y=1/√1.00001=.9999950000；γ2時1.9999900001。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: With an explicit zero gradient and both prior Adam moments zero,theta_new=(1−eta lambda)theta; nonzero prior moments still produce an adaptive update. Decay does not first enter the moments.; Teaching theta2,learning rate.01,decay.1 then.2,with an explicit zero gradient and both prior moments zero.; theta_new=(1−.01×.1)×2=1.998; changed result1.996.

y=gamma(x−mean)/sqrt(variance+epsilon)+beta; define reduction axes and train/eval state.; Teaching values2,4 have mean3 and population variance1; x4,epsilon1e−5,beta0,gamma1 then2.; y=1/sqrt1.00001=.9999950000; gamma2 gives1.9999900001.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: cuBLAS 與 Tensor Core：補齊形狀的有效利用率
related.titleEn: cuBLAS and Tensor Cores: useful work after padding
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付雙路更新圖、零梯度測試及參數群組表。；1.998與1.996吻合，零梯度/None差異與群組設定有紀錄。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver update paths, zero-gradient tests and parameter groups.; Values match and zero/None behavior and group settings are documented.
related.difference: 以有效元素及補齊元素的分母差異評估利用率，而不是只比較核心計時。
related.differenceEn: Evaluate utilization with distinct useful and padded denominators rather than kernel timing alone.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 在顯式零梯度且先前兩個Adam動量皆為零的示例中θ新=(1−ηλ)θ；若舊動量非零仍有梯度路更新。衰減不先混入動量。；教學θ2,η.01,λ.1；顯式梯度及先前兩個動量皆為0；改λ.2。；θ新=(1−.01×.1)×2=1.998；改後1.996。
固定 K 時，補齊矩陣的有用運算比例為 MN/(MpNp)。補零不改變保留區的數學答案。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 M=130、N=70、K=64；教學核心要求 M、N 為 16 的倍數，因此補到 144×80。 有效比例=130×70/(144×80)=0.7899306，即 78.9931%。此 16 倍數是教學核心限制，非所有 cuBLAS 版本通則。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: With an explicit zero gradient and both prior Adam moments zero,theta_new=(1−eta lambda)theta; nonzero prior moments still produce an adaptive update. Decay does not first enter the moments.; Teaching theta2,learning rate.01,decay.1 then.2,with an explicit zero gradient and both prior moments zero.; theta_new=(1−.01×.1)×2=1.998; changed result1.996.

At fixed K, useful-work fraction is MN/(MpNp); zero padding preserves the retained mathematical output. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. M=130, N=70, K=64; a teaching kernel uses multiples of 16, padding to 144×80. Useful fraction=130×70/(144×80)=0.7899306 or 78.9931%; the multiple-of-16 rule belongs to this teaching kernel.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
